recipes.machineType: Natural acquisition: break vanilla mob spawner

conditions.consumeWorldStructure: One BlockMobSpawner with a valid TileEntityMobSpawner is destroyed. This is not an inventory crafting recipe.
conditions.player: Non-creative player on server; uncancelled BreakEvent and HarvestDropsEvent.
conditions.mobRestriction: Spawner entity name must not be blacklisted in PoweredSpawnerConfig.
conditions.requiredOutputNBT: mobType = entity name from original spawner; preserved in the Broken Spawner item.
conditions.scope: Natural dungeon/mineshaft/fortress spawner, independent of Ender Fluidic EndoCrafting loops.

steps: Find an eligible natural mob spawner.
Break it as a survival player using a nonblacklisted tool.
Collect one Broken Spawner carrying the original mobType NBT.

conditions.sourceEntity: EntityEnderman, naturally encountered; no Ender Fluidic EndoCrafting spawner required.
conditions.killSource: LivingDropsEvent damage source entity must be an EntityPlayer.
conditions.ticBranch: For Enderman killed using TiC cleaver or Beheading tag, separate branch: cleaver base0.10 (otherwise0.05)+0.075*Beheading; this branch returns before ordinary FakePlayer multiplier.
conditions.eioOnlyProbabilityFormula: For three independent handlers, if no prior head drop exists: 1-(1-min(1,p))^3. Duplicate-head guard permits at most one EnderIO-added head.
conditions.probabilityScope: Formula describes EnderIO source handlers under stated assumptions. Other mods may add their own head drops; do not convert a desired number of heads to guaranteed kills.

steps: Kill it as a player; looting/powered Dark Steel/TiC Beheading change per-roll chance.
Repeat until the Enderman Head drop is obtained; each successful event yields one head.

notes: These are conditional world acquisitions, not zero-cost repeatable crafting recipes.
Breaking a spawner destroys a naturally generated world structure; head drops are stochastic.
Primordial Pearl boss acquisition not added here: no exact primary implementation source already verified in this task.
